trend.title: Claude's Fable 5.1 Buildathons Pick Bhopal as India's Only Host City
trend.title_original: Claude Fable 5.1 Build Days Launch Worldwide with Bhopal Spotlight
trend.summary_by_grok: Anthropic launched worldwide buildathons from September 11 to 25 to experiment with Fable 5.1, its strongest model yet for long-running coding and knowledge tasks. In India, organizer Aniket Sahu hosts a full-day session in Bhopal on September 20, surprising the tech scene and drawing mixed reactions of humor, appreciation for smaller cities, and light-hearted jabs at skipping bigger hubs. Community buzz highlights the event as a chance to tackle local problems with AI, amid a global rollout across Asia-Pacific, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
trend.summary_original: The Claude community kicked off Fable 5.1 Build Days, a worldwide buildathon from September 11 to 25, inviting people to experiment with Anthropic's new model for coding and complex tasks in cities like Cape Town, Nairobi, Stockholm, Singapore, Tokyo, and Bhopal. Bhopal's selection drew light-hearted reactions, with users joking about Bengaluru folks' surprise while others celebrated the city's rising profile and even quipped about poha stocks soaring. In Bhopal, the sold-out Claude Code Impact Lab focuses on prototyping AI ideas to improve the city, with similar hands-on events planned elsewhere via the Claude Community calendar on Luma.
trend.summary_disclaimer: This story is a summary of posts on X and may evolve over time. Grok can make mistakes, verify its outputs.
